purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: January 26–February 1, 2025 Authority-to-Operations Window
question: Which material federal authority objects signed or initiated from January 26 through February 1, 2025 had acquired a verifiable administrative or operating form by July 29, 2026, and what state had each reached by September 25, 2026?
bluf: Four January 2025 commands acquired inspectable administrative carriers by July 29, 2026: military-readiness direction became a governed personnel process; the Guantánamo migrant-operations memorandum became a named interagency operation; educational-freedom direction became several bounded guidance lanes; and deregulation policy became OMB counting rules plus an operating FAR-rewrite system. Their common factual grammar is command to carrier to workflow to review or formalization—not one coordinated program or proof of policy success.
entities: United States Department of Homeland Security

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains a readable edition and URL.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Use the package finding as orientation, not as a substitute for the report.
Preserve the evidence cutoff. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.

Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
